project.name: Numou Event - Aggregator
project.description:
Business events are the platform's contract between participants. This module separates:
domain-event what a bounded context says happened event-envelope the transport-neutral wrapper (identity, correlation, causation, tenancy, versioning) event-store durable append + replay publisher outbound port subscriber inbound port + idempotency expectation
event-api is the contract other modules compile against; event-spi is what infrastructure adapters (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ...) implement. No broker is named anywhere in this module.
